name: Kurebayashi Kanon
source: Kanon is a 3rd year student who is primarily seen in the library. She loves reading science fiction but is not tech savvy at all. Thanks to the Atropos Watch, she gets closer to the group over time as several people seek her out for reading material related to 'abilities' or special powers.
